arxiv_id.description: Mandatory arxiv id. When non-null the identifier must appear inside the text of an excerpt named by source_evidence_ids; occurring elsewhere in the fetched page grounds nothing, so bind the line that carries it as its own excerpt. A page mention that adds a revision selector (arXiv:2111.11418v3) grounds the unversioned id, but a bare mention does not ground a version you declare.

doi.description: Mandatory doi. When non-null the identifier must appear inside the text of an excerpt named by source_evidence_ids; occurring elsewhere in the fetched page grounds nothing, so bind the line that carries it as its own excerpt. A DOI suffix is opaque, so it is matched exactly and no near variant grounds it.

openreview_id.description: Mandatory openreview id. When non-null the identifier must appear inside the text of an excerpt named by source_evidence_ids; occurring elsewhere in the fetched page grounds nothing, so bind the line that carries it as its own excerpt. An OpenReview id is opaque, so it is matched exactly and no near variant grounds it.

url.description: Mandatory public source URL when available.

source_evidence_ids.description: Mandatory ids of the excerpts that ground this citation. Every non-null citation leaf is value-checked against the concatenated text of these excerpts and nothing else: title, venue, year, each author, and each declared identifier must occur inside that bound text. A value present in the fetched source bytes but not inside a bound excerpt is refused, so bind an excerpt that literally carries each value declared here, adding a second excerpt when the identifier and the title sit on different lines.

locator.description: Mandatory exact location within the source.
Exact license locator in the named source.

evidence_ids.description: Literal license excerpts supporting this source.

source_dispositions.description: Optional per-source dispositions for heterogeneous fetched manifests.

rung.description: Mandatory source-resolution ladder rung, or NO_RUNG_SELECTED when work ended before any rung was selected.

sufficiency_gap.description: Mandatory for insufficient-description skips; names missing implementation detail.

identifier_kind.description: Registry the machine resolved this locator to, or null when it carries no supported identity. Machine-derived: the author is never asked for an identity it cannot read off the page.

identifier.description: Exact registry identifier the machine derived from the locator.

locator.description: Exact locator the author reported observing, retained verbatim.

attempted_at.description: Instant of the bounded machine probe pass that dereferenced this locator.

probe_outcome.description: Closed broker outcome observed for this locator, or null when no probe result was retained.

http_status.description: Exact HTTP status the probe observed. The discriminator for an access barrier: 401, 402, 403 and 451 are withheld rather than absent.

author_claimed_class.description: The author's own closed reading of why it stopped at this locator, retained exactly as claimed. Disagreement with the machine's probe is a checker signal and is deliberately never reconciled here.

rung.description: Selected source-resolution ladder rung. Every member is a positive claim that resolution reached that step; R5_SKIP asserts a checked conclusion that no faithful source path exists.

rung_or_no_selection.description: Selected source-resolution ladder rung, or the explicit NO_RUNG_SELECTED sentinel when author work ended before any rung was selected. The sentinel is never author-selectable and never satisfies an R5 epistemic predicate.

rung.description: Mandatory source-resolution ladder rung, or NO_RUNG_SELECTED when the ladder was never walked.

reason_code.description: Mandatory closed reason code when applicable.

links_checked.description: Mandatory exact content URLs checked. For R2/R4 every entry must bind to fetched, hash-inventoried CAS bytes; unfetched candidate repositories are a coverage gap.

url.description: Mandatory public source URL, except for typed machine discovery evidence.

locator.description: Mandatory exact location within the source.

kind.description: Select an immutable intake-snapshot status source.

content_sha256.description: Intake locators make no fetched-byte digest claim.
Fetched public sources require an exact content digest.

all_agent_fields_have_support.description: Mandatory all agent fields have support.

locator.description: Mandatory exact location within the source.

text_sha256.description: Mandatory hash of the verbatim excerpt.

supports.description: Mandatory supports; claim-category strings matched by exact equality, never by prefix roll-up.

disposition.description: Mandatory excerpt role, including insufficient reimplementation evidence.

license_disposition.description: Mandatory license handling for the retained excerpt.

code_path.description: Mandatory code path. Model-root-relative entry module for a staged rung; null for R1_LIBRARY, which refuses staged code and must use library_recipe instead. Staged code is checked by AST before acceptance and the code YOU WRITE must be FULLY TYPED: every function and method defined in this module, and in every AUTHOR-WRITTEN member of its recursive model-local import closure listed in code_manifest, carries an annotation on every parameter other than self/cls -- including *args and **kwargs -- and a return annotation. One unannotated authored definition anywhere in that closure refuses the whole proposal, and this entry module is never exempt whatever it contains. A closure member that is VERBATIM VENDORED upstream source is exempt from the annotation rule only, and only on proof: it must be declared in upstream_files and its staged bytes must hash to a content_sha256 the controlled-fetch manifest already froze. Editing one character breaks that digest and the file goes straight back under the annotation rule, so vendored bytes must be copied exactly and never adjusted to pass a check. The exemption is for LEGIBILITY only: the dynamic-execution and out-of-sandbox-write checks cover every closure member with no exemption at all, vendored or authored.

code_manifest.description: Closed recursive model-local Python import manifest. Every AUTHOR-WRITTEN member listed here is subject to the same full-annotation AST check as code_path; a member proven to be verbatim vendored upstream bytes (declared in upstream_files, staged digest equal to a frozen controlled-fetch content_sha256) is exempt from that check alone. Every member without exception is checked for dynamic execution and out-of-sandbox writes.

builder_symbol.description: Mandatory builder symbol. Exactly build_model for a staged rung, null otherwise. It must be defined fully annotated -- 'def build_model() -> torch.nn.Module:', not 'def build_model():'; see code_path for the annotation rule that covers every staged function.

dummy_call_symbol.description: Mandatory dummy call symbol. Exactly make_dummy_call for a staged rung, null otherwise. Both parameters and the return need annotations -- 'def make_dummy_call(seed: int, device: str) -> tuple[tuple[object, ...], dict[str, object]]:', not 'def make_dummy_call(seed, device):'; see code_path.

upstream_files.description: Mandatory upstream files. Exact verbatim upstream bytes staged beside the adapter, each bound to a frozen controlled-fetch source. This array is also what proves a closure member was not written by you: a member declared here whose staged bytes hash to the declared, frozen content_sha256 is exempt from the full-annotation AST check that covers authored code. Declare every vendored file; an undeclared one is treated as yours.

torchlens_import_static_check.description: Mandatory torchlens import static-check disposition. 'passed' is an attestation that only a party with an interpreter may make; the author stage has none, so an author declares the honest 'not-checked'.

declared_timeout_seconds.description: Optional author-declared per-forward timeout seconds in [1,1800]; null uses the default.

recipe_type.description: Select terminal records with no executable recipe.

torchlens_import_static_check.description: No-code terminal records cannot run the static import check.
Executable implementations record a real check verdict or the honest 'not-checked'; the no-code sentinel is structurally inexpressible here.

artifact_sha256.description: Machine-derived installed-distribution artifact digest. The author has no package inventory and cannot derive it, so the leaf is optional in an author proposal. The driver resolves it from the routed intent's exact resolved export before gating, matching the declared Python distribution against the inventory package that provides it, and refuses a conflicting or unverifiable supplied value. It is null ONLY when the routed target exposes no package inventory at all; an inventory that does not install the pinned distribution is a typed refusal, never a null.

kwargs.description: Mandatory kwargs. A mapping value carrying the single '__construct__' key is a closed construct node ({module, symbol, kwargs}) resolved from the declared distribution at build time; every other value is literal JSON. Generic torch.nn containers are refused as construct-node symbols.

pretrained_disable_fields.description: Mandatory pretrained disable fields. Names EVERY pinned-constructor keyword that would otherwise load pretrained weights or a checkpoint. This is checked, not merely recorded: every name here must also be a key of kwargs carrying a disabling value (null, false, empty string, 'none', or 'random'), names must not repeat, and each name must be a real keyword parameter of the pinned constructor -- a name absent from that signature is refused when the recipe is loaded. R1_LIBRARY must state its pretrained disposition positively, so an empty array is accepted ONLY together with pretrained_fields_absent true; an empty array with no assertion is refused as silence. Three further checks run whether or not you declare anything, and none can be satisfied by wording: a kwargs key naming a known pretrained keyword (pretrained, weights, encoder_weights, pretrained_backbone, weights_backbone, pretrained_cfg, checkpoint_path and similar) with an enabling value is refused outright; a kwargs key with a known pretrained-asset name that is not listed here is refused until it is declared, so an enabling value can never ride through unlisted; and at load time the real constructor signature is read so that a pretrained keyword left at an ENABLING DEFAULT you never mentioned -- encoder_weights='imagenet' -- is refused before construction.

pretrained_fields_absent.description: Optional positive assertion that the pinned constructor exposes NO pretrained, weights, or checkpoint keyword at all, so there is nothing to disable. This is the honest spelling for a constructor such as MiniMaxForCausalLM(config), a GNN layer, or an SNN, and it is the ONLY way an empty pretrained_disable_fields is accepted. It is checked, not merely recorded: it cannot be combined with a non-empty pretrained_disable_fields (asserting both is a refused contradiction), and it is not taken on trust: the driver re-derives it from the real constructor signature when the recipe is loaded and refuses the recipe if that signature exposes any known pretrained keyword. Absent means false.

entrypoint.description: Optional public non-forward call method for the declarative model, delegated through the crawler-owned transparent adapter and receipted as delegated_method. Null or absent means the native forward. Underscore-prefixed names are refused.

post_construct.description: Optional bounded declarative post-construction configuration calls applied to the constructed model in order, before the runtime provenance tripwire. Plain JSON arguments only; construct nodes are refused here.

method.description: Mandatory public method name invoked on the constructed model; underscore-prefixed names are refused.

args.description: Mandatory plain-JSON positional arguments for the configuration call.

kwargs.description: Mandatory plain-JSON keyword arguments for the configuration call.

disposition.description: Mandatory excerpt role, including insufficient reimplementation evidence.

dtype.description: Mandatory authored, source-read input dtype. Unlike observed.* dtype/device facts, this input_contract leaf is accuracy-gated and contributes to vet identity.

constructor.description: Closed declarative constructor for a non-tensor input object (for example a graph). Required exactly when distribution is 'constructor' and kind is 'constructed'; forbidden otherwise.

kind.description: Constructed leaves declare the closed 'constructed' kind.

module.description: Mandatory dotted import module defining the input constructor.

symbol.description: Mandatory direct constructor attribute resolved on the module.

kwargs.description: Mandatory JSON-only constructor keyword arguments; nested construct nodes follow the same closed grammar and bounds as declarative recipe kwargs.

dtype.description: Mandatory mechanically observed output dtype under observed.*; this root-path placement is TorchLens-derivable and excluded from authored metadata gating.

device.description: Mandatory mechanically observed output device under observed.*; this root-path placement is TorchLens-derivable and excluded from authored metadata gating.

native_framework.description: Worker-observed native framework for the designated measurement attempt.

delegated_method.description: Worker-observed native call method for the designated measurement attempt.

evidence.description: Mandatory literal evidence and coverage record.

reason_code.description: Mandatory closed reason code when applicable.

variant_token.description: Exact trusted intake token selecting the variant.

selector_rule.description: Closed selector-key or direct-symbol specialization rule.

key.description: Exact selector kwarg, or null for a symbol rule.

allowed_recipe_delta.description: The sole permitted representative recipe change.

path.description: Exact recipe path changed by specialization.

previous_value.description: Exact representative value replaced by specialization.

new_value.description: Exact trusted intake token written at the recipe path.

allowed_input_delta.description: Input contract must remain byte-identical to the representative.
